codex_consult.feedback_summary: Round 1 (initial spec): Codex provided 15 findings — effectiveDay framing, EDITOR_MODE removal AC, generate_html signature, 409-soft/HTTP 409 distinction, save concurrency, offline no-queue, Approve stage name, candidates selection derivation, budget response shape, route /api/route constraint, mobile breakpoint, two-step tap, cover image guard, reactive re-render PLAN_DATA, visual output. Round 2 (blocker amendment review): Codex confirmed 6 in-scope findings: (1) B6 imprecision — _check_selected_id_exists must still run for all 7 slots, only STAGE_GATE_VIOLATION restricted to 4; (2) B1 AC26 gap — export gating must use REQUIRED_SLOT_KEYS; (3) B3 effectiveDay merging — same key-presence resolver must apply to effectiveDay, cover image, route, budget; (4) B2/B5 sourceSlotId ambiguity — origin_slot_id must be concrete meal slot, never meals-any; (5) B5 batch payload — spelled out exact two-mutation array for slot-to-slot; (6) W1 DOM vs JSON naming — data-origin-slot-id is DOM attribute, origin_slot_id is JSON field.
